answer: 200 mg: the expected week-16 PASI 75 in the VELA-3 population is 39.3 at 50 mg, 63.7 at 100 mg and 82.8 at 200 mg, so 200 mg is the lowest dose at or above 70 per cent; the VELA-2 arms (46.0, 81.0, 85.0) would have filed 100 mg
analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms the phase 2b data (the central laboratory's concentrations in micrograms per litre against the Lund site's in nanograms per millilitre, the samples below the limit of quantification, the visit windows, the patients who took rescue treatment counted as non-responders under the SAP) and reads the clinical development plan's dose rule correctly takes each arm's week-16 PASI 75 rate, or the Emax curve fitted on dose, the field's dose-response method, and files 100 mg, whose arm cleared the 70 per cent bar in phase 2b; the call is wrong because the phase 3 population weighs more and the antibody's clearance rises with body weight, so at 100 mg its patients run lower trough concentrations and, response following exposure, only 200 mg clears 70 per cent there.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the expected PASI 75 response of a dose in a target population, worked the way clinical pharmacology works a dose choice: a population model of exposure on body weight fitted to the trough concentrations, an exposure-response model fitted to the responses, and the target population's weights carried through both; put into another field's nouns (a school's pupils, a retailer's stores) there is no clearance, no trough concentration and no dose, and the quantity stops making sense.

world.geography: Denmark and Sweden (the phase 2b sites) and North America (the phase 3 sites)
world.org_type: a clinical-stage biotech developing a monoclonal antibody

driver: A response measured at each level of an input in one population is carried to a second population in which every unit takes up less of the same input, because uptake falls with a property the second population carries more of; the response follows the uptake rather than the input level, so the level that cleared a bar in the first population falls short in the second, and only a model of uptake on that property, fitted where uptake was measured, joined to a model of response on uptake, carries the response across.
driver_concrete: The antibody's clearance rises with body weight, so the heavier phase 3 patients run lower trough concentrations at each dose; PASI 75 response follows the trough concentration, so the 100 mg dose that cleared 70 per cent in the Nordic phase 2b falls short of it in the North American phase 3 population and only 200 mg clears it.
stump: A competent solver reads the phase 2b dose-response, the arms' week-16 PASI 75 rates or an Emax curve fitted on dose, and takes 100 mg, which cleared the 70 per cent bar in phase 2b; the phase 3 population weighs more and the antibody's clearance rises with weight, so at 100 mg its patients run lower troughs and the expected response falls under 70 per cent; carried through the weight-clearance relation and the exposure-response fitted on phase 2b, only 200 mg clears the bar.

lineage.fate: retired 2026-11-01 by the batch 1 audit before any portal result: designed before the survivor anatomy gate, its note carries no Actor, Link or Reflex line and precut.py fails it (no Measured by: line); the claims week's refiling pool sized region by region
lineage.driver: A step a weekly count takes each time a calendar period turns is not a fixed seasonal share of the count: it is released by the turn from a pool the closing period built, units refused at their first attempt because their qualifying record had not caught up and admitted once the period moves. The share that comes back differs several-fold between the pool's segments and, within the segments that come back at all, falls steeply with the time from the refusal to the turn, since units refused early have mostly moved on by then, steady within each across past turns; so the step is each segment's pool weighed by when within the period each unit was refused, at the segment's own rates. When the closing period's refusals in the segments that come back most fell late in the period, the segments' pools taken whole at their average rates understate the step, and so do the pool taken whole at the pooled rate and every seasonal forecast.
